annotations.title: Check installed software against fixed versions

description: Compares installed programs and versions (at most 50 items, version optional) with verified fixed versions. Each item is affected (below a verified fixed version, with the incident id), not_affected (at or above it) or unknown (no version, an unparsable version, or no verified fixed version for that program and version line).
